9:12.text: he entered once for all into the Holy Place, taking not the blood of goats and calves but his own blood, thus securing an eternal redemption.

9:24.text: For Christ has entered, not into a sanctuary made with hands, a copy of the true one, but into heaven itself, now to appear in the presence of God on our behalf.

13:11.text: For the bodies of those animals whose blood is brought into the sanctuary by the high priest as a sacrifice for sin are burned outside the camp.

13:12.text: So Jesus also suffered outside the gate in order to sanctify the people through his own blood.

10:14.text: For by a single offering he has perfected for all time those who are sanctified.

10:19.text: Therefore, brethren, since we have confidence to enter the sanctuary by the blood of Jesus,

10:20.text: by the new and living way which he opened for us through the curtain, that is, through his flesh,

10:21.text: and since we have a great priest over the house of God,

9:13.text: For if the sprinkling of defiled persons with the blood of goats and bulls and with the ashes of a heifer sanctifies for the purification of the flesh,

9:14.text: how much more shall the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without blemish to God, purify your conscience from dead works to serve the living God.

10:4.text: For it is impossible that the blood of bulls and goats should take away sins.

9:25.text: Nor was it to offer himself repeatedly, as the high priest enters the Holy Place yearly with blood not his own;

9:26.text: for then he would have had to suffer repeatedly since the foundation of the world. But as it is, he has appeared once for all at the end of the age to put away sin by the sacrifice of himself.
